contexts.text: a. [4]. A good Spirit... in the world... has been wiser in his Internal than in his External; in his External also he was sometimes led astray through the allurements and vanities of the world.
Various allurements that entice to marriage...
This is spoken of the male sex, because it has allurements that actually inflame it.
There is a closer union with allurements with a concubine than with a wife.
The allurements of the love of evil, which in themselves are concupiscences...
Concupiscence is as a deed when it is in the will, for only allurement enters into the understanding, but into the will intention...
The allurements of the eye and concupiscences of the flesh...
Kisses nature, and loves it from the allurements of its pleasures.
